name: Benchmark Media Systems
_refused: benchmarkmedia.com/policies/terms-of-service, read 2026-11-25 with curl. TWO independently sufficient clauses, the Shopify template that Hidizs also carries: « You must not reproduce, distribute, modify, create derivative works of, publicly display, publicly perform, republish, download, store, or transmit any of the material on the Services without our prior written consent. » and, in the list of prohibited uses, « (b) reproduce, duplicate, copy, sell, resell or exploit any portion of the Services; [...] (d) spam, phish, pharm, pretext, spider, crawl, or scrape ». A third disclaims any implied grant: « nothing in these Terms grants or shall be construed as granting a license or other rights to you under any patent, trademark, copyright, or other intellectual property of Benchmark Media Systems, Shopify or any third party. » Footer: « © 2026 Benchmark Media Systems ». robots.txt names adsbot-google and carries no Content-Signal. No product page was opened and no record will exist under this brand.
_it_can_be_lifted: « without our prior written consent » - conditioned, so Benchmark belongs on the letter list, and it is the one worth writing first. What is lost is unusually specific: Benchmark publishes MEASUREMENTS of its own converters to a standard no other maker in this catalogue matches, and the DAC3 family's published THD+N, dynamic range and jitter figures are the kind of fact this base has almost none of - every analog-performance field here is empty. They also document their own PCM/DSD level behaviour, which is the field our vocabulary singles out as impossible to get except from someone holding the hardware.
_the_terms_page_was_nearly_missed: How this was found matters for the next brand. A first pass grepped the homepage for links containing term|legal|condition|polic and reported /policies/privacy-policy, /policies/refund-policy and /policies/shipping-policy - no terms page - which would have put Benchmark in the « no prohibition found » column and let eleven records be written. The terms link IS on that homepage; the first grep's output was truncated at three matches by a head -8 that also had to cover other hosts. THE ABSENCE OF A TERMS PAGE MUST BE ESTABLISHED BY ENUMERATING ALL legal links, not by reading the first few. Shopify serves them at /policies/terms-of-service on every store, and that path should be probed by name on any Shopify host regardless of what the footer shows.
_CE_REFUS_N_EST_PAS_NEUF: La note _refused ci-dessus a ete ecrite le 25/11 au soir comme s'il s'agissait d'un refus nouveau. IL NE L'EST PAS : _REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS.benchmark_media le portait deja, commite le meme jour, avec la meme conclusion et plus de detail - notamment ce qui a ete jete, que ma note ne disait pas. Les deux textes concordent, aucun n'est a retirer, et le registre reste l'autorite. C'est conserve parce que la cause est interessante : j'avais cru verifier le registre en cherchant une cle _refused dans database/brands/*.json, ou j'en ai compte dix-sept, alors que le registre vit dans le vocabulaire et comptait vingt-six marques. Trois marques remesurees pour rien, et une quatrieme - Okto Research - recoltee contre son refus. LE REGISTRE SE LIT DANS LE VOCABULAIRE.
